require 'json'
require 'fluent/config/error'
require 'fluent/config/yaml_parser/fluent_value'
require 'fluent/config/yaml_parser/parser'

# Based on https://github.com/eagletmt/hako/blob/34cdde06fe8f3aeafd794be830180c3cedfbb4dc/lib/hako/yaml_loader.rb

module Fluent
  module Config
    module YamlParser
      class Loader
        INCLUDE_TAG = 'tag:include'.freeze
        FLUENT_JSON_TAG = 'tag:fluent/json'.freeze
        FLUENT_STR_TAG = 'tag:fluent/s'.freeze
        SHOVEL = '<<'.freeze

        def initialize(context = Kernel.binding)
          @context = context
          @current_path = nil
        end

        # @param [String] path
        # @return [Hash]
        def load(path)
          class_loader = Psych::ClassLoader.new
          scanner = Psych::ScalarScanner.new(class_loader)

          visitor = Visitor.new(scanner, class_loader)

          visitor._register_domain(INCLUDE_TAG) do |_, val|
            load(path.parent.join(val))
          end

          visitor._register_domain(FLUENT_JSON_TAG) do |_, val|
            Fluent::Config::YamlParser::FluentValue::JsonValue.new(val)
          end

          visitor._register_domain(FLUENT_STR_TAG) do |_, val|
            Fluent::Config::YamlParser::FluentValue::StringValue.new(val, @context)
          end

          path.open do |f|
            visitor.accept(Psych.parse(f))
          end
        end

        class Visitor < Psych::Visitors::ToRuby
          def initialize(scanner, class_loader)
            super(scanner, class_loader)
          end

          def _register_domain(name, &block)
            @domain_types.merge!({ name => [name, block] })
          end

          def revive_hash(hash, o)
            super(hash, o).tap do |r|
              if r[SHOVEL].is_a?(Hash)
                h2 = {}
                r.each do |k, v|
                  if k == SHOVEL
                    h2.merge!(v)
                  else
                    h2[k] = v
                  end
                end
                r.replace(h2)
              end
            end
          end
        end

        def build(config)
          parser = config.is_a?(Parser) ? config : Parser.new(config)
          eval_context = @context
          loaded_config = parser.config
          base_indent = parser.base_indent

          section_build = nil
          config_build = nil
          label_build = nil
          worker_build = nil
          filter_build = nil
          match_build = nil
          included_sections_build = nil

          wrap_section = lambda do |section, indent|
            marker = Fluent::Config::Element.new(section.name, section.arg.nil? ? '' : section.arg.to_s, {}, [])
            SectionBuilder.new(marker.name, section.body, indent, section.arg)
          end

          included_sections_build = lambda do |cfg, section_builder, indent: 0|
            cfg.each_entry do |e|
              k = e.keys.first
              cc = e.delete(k)
              case k
              when 'label'
                section_builder.bodies << label_build.call(cc, indent: indent)
              when 'worker'
                section_builder.bodies << worker_build.call(cc, indent: indent)
              when 'source'
                section_builder.bodies << section_build.call('source', cc, indent: indent)
              when 'filter'
                section_builder.bodies << filter_build.call(cc, indent: indent)
              when 'match'
                section_builder.bodies << match_build.call(cc, indent: indent)
              end
            end
          end

          config_build = lambda do |cfg, indent: 0, root: false|
            sb = SectionBodyBuilder.new(indent, root: root)
            cfg.each do |c|
              if (lc = c.delete('label'))
                sb.bodies << label_build.call(lc, indent: indent)
              end

              if (sc = c.delete('source'))
                sb.bodies << section_build.call('source', sc, indent: indent)
              end

              if (fc = c.delete('filter'))
                sb.bodies << filter_build.call(fc, indent: indent)
              end

              if (mc = c.delete('match'))
                sb.bodies << match_build.call(mc, indent: indent)
              end

              if (wc = c.delete('worker'))
                sb.bodies << worker_build.call(wc, indent: indent)
              end

              included_sections_build.call(c, sb, indent: indent)
            end

            sb
          end

          label_build = lambda do |cfg, indent: 0|
            cfg = cfg.dup
            name = cfg.delete('$name')
            c = cfg.delete('config')
            wrap_section.call(SectionBuilder.new('label', config_build.call(c, indent: indent + base_indent), indent, name), indent)
          end

          worker_build = lambda do |cfg, indent: 0|
            cfg = cfg.dup
            num = cfg.delete('$arg')
            c = cfg.delete('config')
            wrap_section.call(SectionBuilder.new('worker', config_build.call(c, indent: indent + base_indent), indent, num), indent)
          end

          filter_build = lambda do |cfg, indent: 0|
            cfg = cfg.dup
            tag = cfg.delete('$tag')
            if tag.is_a?(Array)
              section_build.call('filter', cfg, indent: indent, arg: tag&.join(','))
            else
              section_build.call('filter', cfg, indent: indent, arg: tag)
            end
          end

          match_build = lambda do |cfg, indent: 0|
            cfg = cfg.dup
            tag = cfg.delete('$tag')
            if tag.is_a?(Array)
              section_build.call('match', cfg, indent: indent, arg: tag&.join(','))
            else
              section_build.call('match', cfg, indent: indent, arg: tag)
            end
          end

          section_build = lambda do |name, cfg, indent: 0, arg: nil|
            sb = SectionBodyBuilder.new(indent + base_indent)

            if (v = cfg.delete('$type'))
              sb.bodies << SectionBodyBuilder::Row.new('@type', v, sb.indent)
            end

            if (v = cfg.delete('$label'))
              sb.bodies << SectionBodyBuilder::Row.new('@label', v, sb.indent)
            end

            if (v = cfg.delete('$id'))
              sb.bodies << SectionBodyBuilder::Row.new('@id', v, sb.indent)
            end

            cfg.each do |key, val|
              if val.is_a?(Array)
                val.each do |v|
                  sb.bodies << section_build.call(key, v, indent: indent + base_indent)
                end
              elsif val.is_a?(Hash)
                harg = val.delete('$arg')
                if harg.is_a?(Array)
                  sb.bodies << section_build.call(key, val, indent: indent + base_indent, arg: harg&.join(','))
                else
                  sb.bodies << section_build.call(key, val, indent: indent + base_indent, arg: harg)
                end
              else
                if val.is_a?(FluentValue::StringValue)
                  ctx = val.context || eval_context
                  val = FluentValue::StringValue.new(val.val, ctx)
                end
                sb.bodies << SectionBodyBuilder::Row.new(key, val, sb.indent)
              end
            end

            wrap_section.call(SectionBuilder.new(name, sb, indent, arg), indent)
          end

          system_section = loaded_config['system'] && section_build.call('system', loaded_config['system'])
          conf_body = loaded_config['config'] && config_build.call(loaded_config['config'], root: true)
          root = RootBuilder.new(system_section, conf_body)
          RootBuilder.new(root.system, root.conf)
        end

      end
    end
  end
end

      k1 root_config
      include dir/config_test_2.conf  #

      include file://#{TMP_DIR}/config_test_5.conf
      <include config.d/*.conf />
    ]
    write_config "#{TMP_DIR}/dir/config_test_2.conf", %[
      k2 relative_path_include

      k3 relative_include_in_included_file
    ]
    write_config "#{TMP_DIR}/config_test_4.conf", %[
      k4 absolute_path_include
    ]
    write_config "#{TMP_DIR}/config_test_5.conf", %[
      k5 uri_include
    ]
    write_config "#{TMP_DIR}/config.d/config_test_6.conf", %[

    write_config "#{TMP_DIR}/config.d/config_test_8.conf", %[
      <elem2 name>
        <include ../dir/config_test_9.conf />
      </elem2>
    ]
    write_config "#{TMP_DIR}/dir/config_test_9.conf", %[
      k9 embedded
      <elem3 name>
        nested nested_value
        include hoge
      </elem3>
    ]
    write_config "#{TMP_DIR}/config.d/00_config_test_8.conf", %[
      k8 wildcard_include_3

        include normal_parameter
      </elem4>
    ]

  end

  def test_include
    prepare_config
    c = read_config("#{TMP_DIR}/config_test_1.conf")
    assert_equal 'root_config', c['k1']
    assert_equal 'relative_path_include', c['k2']
    assert_equal 'relative_include_in_included_file', c['k3']
    assert_equal 'absolute_path_include', c['k4']
    assert_equal 'uri_include', c['k5']
    assert_equal 'wildcard_include_1', c['k6']
    assert_equal 'wildcard_include_2', c['k7']
    assert_equal 'wildcard_include_3', c['k8']
    assert_equal [
      'k1',
      'k2',
      'k3',
      'k4',
      'k5',
      'k8', # Because of the file name this comes first.
      'k6',
      'k7',
    ], c.keys

    elem1 = c.elements.find { |e| e.name == 'elem1' }
    assert_not_nil elem1
    assert_equal 'name', elem1.arg
    assert_equal 'normal_parameter', elem1['include']

    elem2 = c.elements.find { |e| e.name == 'elem2' }
    assert_not_nil elem2
    assert_equal 'name', elem2.arg
    assert_equal 'embedded', elem2['k9']
    assert !elem2.has_key?('include')

    elem3 = elem2.elements.find { |e| e.name == 'elem3' }
    assert_not_nil elem3
    assert_equal 'nested_value', elem3['nested']
    assert_equal 'hoge', elem3['include']
  end

  def test_check_not_fetchd
    write_config "#{TMP_DIR}/config_test_not_fetched.conf", %[
      <match dummy>
       type          rewrite
       add_prefix    filtered
       <rule>
         key     path
         pattern ^[A-Z]+
         replace
       </rule>
     </match>
    ]
    root_conf  = read_config("#{TMP_DIR}/config_test_not_fetched.conf")
    match_conf = root_conf.elements.first
    rule_conf  = match_conf.elements.first

    not_fetched = []; root_conf.check_not_fetched {|key, e| not_fetched << key }
    assert_equal %w[type add_prefix key pattern replace], not_fetched

    not_fetched = []; match_conf.check_not_fetched {|key, e| not_fetched << key }
    assert_equal %w[type add_prefix key pattern replace], not_fetched

    not_fetched = []; rule_conf.check_not_fetched {|key, e| not_fetched << key }
    assert_equal %w[key pattern replace], not_fetched

    # accessing should delete
    match_conf['type']
    rule_conf['key']

    not_fetched = []; root_conf.check_not_fetched {|key, e| not_fetched << key }
    assert_equal %w[add_prefix pattern replace], not_fetched

    not_fetched = []; match_conf.check_not_fetched {|key, e| not_fetched << key }
    assert_equal %w[add_prefix pattern replace], not_fetched

    not_fetched = []; rule_conf.check_not_fetched {|key, e| not_fetched << key }
    assert_equal %w[pattern replace], not_fetched

    # repeatedly accessing should not grow memory usage
    before_size = match_conf.unused.size
    10.times { match_conf['type'] }
    assert_equal before_size, match_conf.unused.size
  end
